name: Forge Ardent
description: Forgeron de guerre armant les combattants avec des armes chauffées à blanc infligeant des brûlures persistantes.

subject.archetype: Forge Ardent — Héritiers des cendres Uncommon class spore

loadout.armor_outfit: Armor forged from melted debris and volcanic slag, dark metal plates held by thermal bonds glowing orange at every seam, heat distortion rising from every surface, scorch marks and soot coating every inch
loadout.arsenal: Dual flame projector gauntlets superheated to molten temperatures dripping liquid fire, volcanic glass blade still glowing cherry red at core, ash grenades on belt radiating heat The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's growing ability targeting all_own, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Pyromancer wielding devastating flames with mastery, fire erupting from every gesture and command. Arms raised high in commanding gesture with focused targeted energy web radiating outward from chest in all directions, each thread connecting to different allied position across battlefield
attitude.emotion: Battle-tested confidence — knowing skills will carry through the engagement

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

scenography.setting: Volcanic battlefield mid-eruption with lava rivers bursting through cracked ground flowing around combat zone, character standing in center of massive firestorm, burning debris raining from ash-choked sky, enemy positions engulfed in flames with structures collapsing into molten ground
